Update5 June 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - Jun 5, 2026
More space, better coordination, stranger Meadows. This patch adds a fully functional 5th shortcut bar, Comet's Beacon for raid/party markers, a new Golden Token toy, Kapiros improvements, and the final Egg Basket Teleport Scroll fixes. Something shady is stirring near Kapiros…

Features

  • An additional shortcut bar has been added to the game.
    • Enabling the 5th bar can be found in "Options" -> "Game Settings" -> "Shortcuts"
    • Keybinds can be set in "Options" -> "Key Settings" -> "Shortcut Bars"
    • This bar, unlike the last version, supports items, skills, equipment, as expected.
    • Please note: The action slot information is stored locally, and will not persist between computers.
  • A new Golden Token toy has been added, that will be released in an upcoming Marketplace update.
  • Added the item "Comet's Beacon" which allows party or raid leaders to spawn a beacon of light only visible by members of their party or raid, at a location of their choosing.
    • Only broadcast to other players if they are in your raid/party AND you are leader.
  • Added a corresponding crafting recipe under Artistry for making Comet's Beacon.
  • It's been reported that there has been shady activities happening in Swirling Meadows around Kapiros' habitat

Bug Fixes

  • Kapiros's determination to collect Barrels of Oranges grows stronger, he will not let anything take him off the path towards his mission.
  • The saga to fix the Egg Basket Teleport Scroll is over, it is usable around Nui and Dungeon peace zones.
  • The new loading screen has now been properly applied
  • The Floodcaller's Storm transmutation recipe has been fixed to no longer give a Fiendfinder. Thanks @dantrag for the report!
  • The Lifestealer transmutation recipe has been aligned with the material requirements of the original recipe. Thanks @sheoix for the report!

== Features ==
* An additional shortcut bar has been added to the game.
** Enabling the 5th bar can be found in "Options" -> "Game Settings" -> "Shortcuts"
** Keybinds can be set in "Options" -> "Key Settings" -> "Shortcut Bars"
** This bar, unlike the last version, supports items, skills, equipment, as expected.
** Please note: The action slot information is stored locally, and will not persist between computers.
* A new Golden Token toy has been added, that will be released in an upcoming Marketplace update.
* Added the item "Comet's Beacon" which allows party or raid leaders to spawn a beacon of light only visible by members of their party or raid, at a location of their choosing.
** Only broadcast to other players if they are in your raid/party AND you are leader.
* Added a corresponding crafting recipe under Artistry for making Comet's Beacon.
* It's been reported that there has been shady activities happening in Swirling Meadows around Kapiros' habitat

== Bug Fixes ==
* Kapiros's determination to collect Barrels of Oranges grows stronger, he will not let anything take him off the path towards his mission.
* The saga to fix the Egg Basket Teleport Scroll is over, it is usable around Nui and Dungeon peace zones.
* The new loading screen has now been properly applied
* The Floodcaller's Storm transmutation recipe has been fixed to no longer give a Fiendfinder. Thanks @dantrag for the report!
* The Lifestealer transmutation recipe has been aligned with the material requirements of the original recipe. Thanks @sheoix for the report!
